newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cosmos lowers price for preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos lowers price for preferred shares.

text.p: The board of directors of Cosmos Bottling Corp has lowered the offer price of its preferred share issue to 4.20 pesos from 5.21 pesos, parent RFM Corp said on Tuesday.
The board also reduced the size of the issue to 1.2 billion pesos from 1.5 billion pesos.
"Cosmos does not need that much money. It has lots of cash from operations," B.J. Sebastian, vice-president of RFM Corp, told Reuters.

Cosmos submitted its amended terms for the preferred share issue to the Securities and Exchange Commission. It sought the registration of 287.5 million preferred convertible shares with a par value of one peso.
The dividend rate remained at five percent per annum.
One preferred share will be issued for every three Cosmos common shares held.

The conversion period will start 18 months after the date of issue. The company said shareholders can convert their preferred shares to common stock at a rate of one preferred share for one common share.
Sebastian said the record date for the preferred share issue would be set after the Philippine Stock Exchange approved the listing of the issue.
Proceeds of the offer will be used to modernise and expand capacity.
